canonical_statement: Eligible participants were adults aged 18-75 years with group 1 PAH confirmed by right heart catheterization within 6 months, 6MWD at least 50 m, PVR at least 6 WU, and no prior PAH therapy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: SELECTION OF PATIENTS. Patients (18-75 years of age) diagnosed with PAH (group 1 pulmonary hyper- tension), including idiopathic, heritable, or drug- and toxin-induced PAH, or PAH associated with connec- tive tissue disease, human immunodeﬁciency virus infection, or corrected congenital heart disease (sim- ple systemic-to-pulmonary shunts $1 year after repair) conﬁrmed by right heart catheterization within 6 months prior to randomization were eligible. Patients had 6-minute walk distance (6MWD) $50 m and pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) $6 WU and were excluded if previously treated with PAH ther- apy. Eligibility criteria are listed in the protocol in the Supplemental Appendix. Written informed consent was obtained from all patients. TRIAL PROCEDURES. Patients were randomized 1:1 to initial triple oral therapy (macitentan, tadalaﬁl, and selexipag) or initial double oral therapy (maci- tentan, tadalaﬁl, and placebo) within 28 days of screening (Supplemental Figure 1). Randomization was stratiﬁed by region (rest of the world vs North America) and World Health Organization functional class (FC) at baseline (I and II vs III and IV).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Supplementary Figure 2. Initiation and titration of selexipag. Tadalafil starting dose was 20 mg o.d. and increased to 40 mg o.d. on Day 8±3 based on individual tolerability. Selexipag/placebo starting dose was 200 µg b.i.d. The individualized maintenance dose for each patient was identified by up-titration in increments of 200 µg b.i.d., typically at weekly intervals, until either the maximum dose of 1600 µg b.i.d. was reached or adverse pharmacological effects could not be tolerated or medically managed, whichever occurred first. source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 6. Imputation rules The following imputation rules were applied for the main analyses. Primary end-point Missing values at week 26 for PVR were imputed with the last observation carried forward. For patients with a post-baseline PVR measurement obtained before week 26, the last post-baseline PVR measurement was carried forward. For patients without a post-baseline PVR measurement, the baseline PVR was carried forward (i.e., the ratio of week 26 to baseline was set to one). Patients with missing baseline PVR measurement were excluded from analysis.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: CONCLUSIONS In TRITON, the primary endpoint of change in PVR at week 26 was not met.
